channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: DePaul Cleared To Build New Athletic Complex In Lincoln Park, Replacing Century-Old Homes
item.description: The facility, which will replace four 1890s rowhouses and a student apartment building, was redesigned multiple times to address preservation concerns and neighborhood feedback.

item.title: With Dueling Budget Proposals, City Council No Closer To Compromise As Shutdown Deadline Looms
item.description: A group of 27 alderpeople introduced a set of alternative budget proposals to City Council that would scrap a corporate head tax. Mayor Brandon Johnson has doubled down on his support of the idea.

item.title: CTA Study Could Yield Bus Lanes, Improvements On Major Streets Like Cottage Grove, 55th
item.description: Bus routes along 55th Street, Pulaski Road and Cottage Grove, Fullerton and Western avenues could benefit from street redesigns and safety improvements. The CTA seeks rider feedback ahead of its final recommendations next year.

item.title: Proposed Hemp Ban Adds Exemption For THC Drinks
item.description: Small business owners selling intoxicating hemp often as edibles, vapes and flower are still on the chopping block — but a vote on the proposed ban was delayed Wednesday by allies of Mayor Brandon Johnson.

item.title: Southside Blooms Flower Shop Expanding To North Lawndale This Spring
item.description: The Englewood nonprofit is opening a West Side facility to meet growing demand. Its founder was recently named CNN's "hero" of the year for his work with vulnerable youth.

item.title: Near North Health Opens Bronzeville Clinic, Offering Outpatient Family Services
item.description: The clinic relocated from its Berkeley Avenue location last week. It will host an open house Saturday to welcome neighbors.

item.title: Despite Teachers In Closets And Classes In Hallways, CPS Says NW Side School Isn’t Overcrowded
item.description: Parents and teachers at the Albany Park school pushed to relocate part of its student body to a former charter school building that houses another CPS school, but the district said the move would be too disruptive.

item.title: 21 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Cocoa Crawl, Vintage Book Sale, Many Holiday Markets
item.description: Shop local at the Dovetail Holiday Market, the Chicago Art Girls Holiday Pop-Up, the PullmanArts Holiday Market, Schubas Winter Market and more.

item.title: Soccer House Bar Is Taking Over The Former Twisted Spoke Just In Time For World Cup
item.description: Soccer House will air soccer matches — and only soccer matches — in three unique viewing areas. Owner Garret Drexler plans to open the bar-restaurant ahead of next year’s World Cup.

item.title: Krystal Rivera’s Partner Shot Her During Foot Chase After Romantic Relationship Ended, Lawsuit Says
item.description: Officer Carlos Baker was struggling to get over the end of his relationship with Officer Krystal Rivera when he fatally shot her in a police chase gone wrong, according to the new lawsuit brought by Rivera's mother.
